item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of good prompts: does this moment support the life you're trying to create, and am I projecting or mind reading. Those questions only work if you answer them honestly in the moment, not just read them. Notice where a story is running ahead of the facts today. Action: when one of those reminders pops up, pause, take one breath, and answer it out loud.
